# Hex

> Hex is local voice dictation for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Hold a shortcut, speak, and Hex transcribes on the device and pastes the text wherever the cursor is.

- Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later): https://anoma.ly/hex/files/releases/HEX-latest-arm64.dmg, or `brew install --cask anomalyco/tap/hex`
- Windows 10 or 11 beta, x64 and ARM64: per-user Setup.exe installers at __ORIGIN__/
- Linux beta, x86_64 Arch with glibc 2.44 or later: `curl -fsSL https://anoma.ly/hex/files/install-linux.sh | sh`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/README.md): features, settings, privacy, and troubleshooting
- [Windows guide](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/windows.md)
- [Linux guide](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/docs/linux.md)
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/anomalyco/hex/blob/dev/sdk/typescript/README.md): local transcription for other apps
